subject: PO onboarding kickoff & guidance for line-item structure
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: procure@acme-analytics.com
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com, lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO onboarding kickoff & guidance for line-item structure

Hi Jordan / Sofia,

Thanks for the call earlier. Per our procurement team, we'd like to kick off vendor setup and confirm the PO process before we schedule the integration work. A few specific asks to get us moving: 

- Do you require a formal PO prior to the first invoice for new customers? If yes, do you accept a scanned PDF PO or do you require a purchase order via EDI?
- What is your typical PO issuance timeline once a vendor is set up (standard business days)?
- Please confirm the preferred line-item structure on the PO: do you want one line per subscription term, separate lines for support/training, taxes listed separately, and whether you need unit pricing + quantity?
- Please upload your W-9 and remit instructions so our AP team can complete vendor setup.

I've attached our internal onboarding checklist so you can see the fields our vendor team will need. If helpful, Rishi and Lauren are copied to confirm internal timelines.

Attachments: [Redwood_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx]

Next steps: Jordan, can you confirm requirements and an estimated timeline today or tomorrow?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Director | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Jordan Lee <procure@acme-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: vendor-ops@acme-analytics.com (Sofia Ruiz)
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO onboarding kickoff & guidance for line-item structure

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick answers below: 

1) PO requirement: Yes, Acme requires a formal PO for enterprise contracts prior to processing the first invoice. We can accept a signed PDF PO via email; EDI is supported but optional for first-time customers.

2) Issuance timeline: Once vendor setup is complete and we have a signed order, PO issuance typically takes 3–5 business days. If we have everything (W-9, remit info, legal fully executed) it can be as quick as 2 business days.

3) Line-item structure guidance (our preference):
   - One line per subscription SKU (SKU ID, short description), unit price, quantity = 1, subscription term dates in the description.
   - Support & implementation: separate line(s) with clear description and one-time vs monthly billing cadence.
   - Training/Professional Services: separate line items with service period and deliverable notes.
   - Taxes: listed as separate line (we prefer tax calculated at invoice but can accept tax-exempt flag if provided).

Attached is our W-9. I'll ask our finance ops (Sofia) to confirm if we need any additional tax forms for international payments.

Attachment: [W9_AcmeAnalytics.pdf]

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call if you want to walk through a sample PO.

Cheers,
Jordan Lee
Procurement Manager, Acme Analytics
procure@acme-analytics.com

Marissa / Lauren —

Couple of internal clarifications from Finance:

- Redwood requires a PO number before paying the first invoice for new vendors unless there is an approved one-time exception. Please treat PO issuance as a gating item.
- Preferred PO format: PDF with visible PO number + line items. We can process EDI if Acme wants to send it that way but it's not required.
- Recommended line-item template (to align with our AP system):
   • SKU / Item Code (if available)
   • Short description (include term dates: start / end)
   • Unit price
   • Quantity
   • Line-level tax indicator (Y/N)
   • Order/Contract reference (e.g., ACME-2026-MAR / Redwood SOW #42)

I attached our PO template to speed handoffs to Acme. If Acme prefers that we populate and issue the PO, we can do that as soon as the vendor form and W-9 are in our portal. Standard internal issuance SLA is 2 business days after vendor setup completes; escalate to me if it looks like it's going to exceed 7 business days.

Attachment: [PO_template_Redwood.docx]

Rishi
Head of Sales Ops | Redwood Inference

Hi Jordan / Sofia,

Thanks — confirming Redwood's requirements and next steps on our side: 

1) PO before invoice: Confirmed. We require a PO number for first invoice payment unless a one-time finance exception is approved.

2) Vendor setup items needed from Acme (please return to vendor-ops@redwoodinference.com):
   - Completed vendor onboarding form (I will send via DocuSign shortly)
   - W-9 (received)
   - Remit instructions (bank details or third-party payment platform)
   - Primary billing contact name + email

3) PO issuance timeline: Once vendor form + W-9 + remit info are in our portal, Finance will issue a PO within 2 business days. If you need us to draft the PO first, we can generate a Redwood-issued PO and send for your approval.

4) Line-item structure: We align with Acme's guidance above. Please ensure subscription SKUs are present on the PO and that the service term is visible in the description field. We will not split recurring subscription into multiple line items unless there are separate SKUs.

DocuSign: I've sent the Vendor Onboarding Form to the email you used on the call. Link: https://docusign.com/envelopes/0A12BC3D

If anything blocks vendor setup beyond next Wednesday (2026-03-04), please escalate to me and Rishi. Hannah from Security is copied to confirm there are no outstanding compliance items.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Finance Manager | Redwood Inference
